title: Dihedral 2-Design Second Frame Potential F_2(D_Q; A) = 0.5 * E_4(A) Additive Energy Identity
claims: For the 2Q-element dihedral group D_Q = Z_q^n rtimes {I, X^{otimes K}} on K wires, all Q reflection elements have trace zero, and the second frame potential equals F_2(D_Q; A) = 0.5 * E_4(A), where E_4(A) is the 4-tuple subset-sum additive energy.
Colliding subset-sum instances strictly increase E_4(A) and F_2(D_Q; A) above the flat bijection baseline 2^{4K-1}/Q >> F_2(Haar) = 2.
favorable_controls: Zero matrix control A=[[0,0,0]] mod 8 (E_4=4096, F_2=2048)
